uutiset.t: Alcaraz beats Zverev to claim elusive ATP Finals title
uutiset.s: Carlos Alcaraz secured his maiden Nitto ATP Finals title with a straight-sets victory over top seed Alexander Zverez in Turin.

uutiset.s: Mauricio Pochettino felt Manchester United were given an "unfair" red card in their 4-0 defeat at Liverpool - with Kobbie Mainoo replying "no chance" when asked whether Leny Yoro should have been sent off.

uutiset.t: What a play! Ravens score 52-yard flea-flicker TD
uutiset.s: Jacoby Brissett combines with Justice Hill on a clever flea-flicker before finding a wide-open Rashod Bateman for a 52-yard touchdown against the Carolina Panthers.

uutiset.t: Nightmare start for Pochettino as Liverpool rout 10-man Man Utd
uutiset.s: Mauricio Pochettino endured a horror start to his Manchester United tenure as his 10-man side were thrashed 4-0 by Liverpool at Anfield following Leny Yoro's early sending off.

Camara to sacrifice F2 title bid to finish F1 season with Haas
uutiset.s: Haas have confirmed Rafael Camara will continue to feature for the team in the final two Formula 1 races of the season, rather than challenge for the Formula 2 championship.

uutiset.t: Littler values 'titles and legacy' over money as he launches new initiative
uutiset.s: Luke Littler says "titles and legacy" are more important to him than money after joining forces with a youth unemployment charity to help those in his native north west of England.

Genge eager for England to build on victory in All Blacks rematch
uutiset.s: Ellis Genge called on England to back up their record victory over New Zealand as they go in search of an unprecedented hat-trick against the All Blacks.

uutiset.t: McBurnie's late double stuns 10-man Brighton after Tzolakis heroics
uutiset.s: A Konstantinos Tzolakis goalkeeping masterclass teed up Oli McBurnie to score two late goals as Hull stunned dominant Brighton in a smash-and-grab 2-0 win at the MKM Stadium.

uutiset.t: Punishing start for Pochettino as size of Man Utd mess made clear
uutiset.s: Well, they ran. They had to because there were only 10 of them for all but the first seven minutes. If running were the only problem then this mess might soon be solvable. But Manchester United's 4-0 defeat to Liverpool at Anfield highlighted more flaws than that.
